frequency_question: How often do motivated state principals successfully deliver domestic manufacturing lines for complex guided weapons within the target timeframe?
membership_rule: Includes sovereign states initiating domestic production of foreign-designed advanced cruise or tactical missiles under active wartime mobilization; excludes purely civilian manufacturing or basic small-arms transfers.

cases.name: Ukraine domestic production of Stugna-P/Neptune variants post-2022
Iran domestic reverse-engineering and production lines of foreign missile designs (e.g., Fateh series)
Taiwan Hsiung Feng missile domestic production scaling
Pakistan Babur cruise missile domestic production initiation
South Africa Project Y/Hartebeesrivier missile development and production

coverage_note: 5 named; believed roughly 6 in total globally meeting stringent criteria
known_gaps: Classified domestic programs in smaller nations lacking public documentation.
skeleton: 5 documented major historical instances of sovereign states attempting rapid domestic advanced missile manufacturing lines under high priority constraints
validity_reason: Industrial base structures and state-directed wartime manufacturing paradigms evolve slowly over decades.
